title: Kevin Stefanski: We'll have a better idea Wednesday about Michael Penix

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kevin Stefanski: We'll have a better idea Wednesday about Michael Penix
sources.description: Multiple reports on Monday said that Falcons quarterback Michael Penix avoided a serious injury to his ribs when he was hurt late in Sunday night's loss to the Ravens, but head coach Kevin Stefanski isn't ready to make any comments about his availability for Week 6.
